key_findings: Pterostilbene alleviates CYP-induced bladder pain and inflammation by activating Nrf2/HO-1 and suppressing NLRP3, caspase-1 and GSDMD.
Nrf2/HO-1 inhibitors ML385 and ZnPP abolished PTE effects.
